title: Evidence and proof declaration — structural placeholder
description: Bounded proof subjects, retaining the distinction between occurrence, carrier, record, representation, and interpretation.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

object.description: Exact object of the proof claim.

method.description: Method and evidence model used, without exceeding that method's proof ceiling.

scope.description: Bounds of the claim and relevant Locality or relation.

time.description: Time or occurrence to which the claim applies.

basis.description: Attributable support relied on by the claim.

result.description: Bounded result, preserving non-verification without turning it into a verified negative.

effect_ceiling.description: What the proof supports and what it cannot establish by itself.

occurrence.description: Event claimed, distinct from its preservation or interpretation.

carrier.description: Carrier of evidence, not the occurrence itself.

record.description: Preserved account, which does not cause the reported result.

representation.description: Represented surface, not an unexposed interior.

interpretation.description: Reading or inference kept distinct from the evidence objects.
